Chapter 6465: You May Rise

Chapter 6465: You May Rise

The voice pierced everyone’s heart and spirit. Even the deaf could hear him clearly in their mind.

“Lord Alcch-deer.” An image of a great being popped in their mind.

A great tree capable of blotting out the sky became resplendent. Ocean-gaze and the others had incredible trees but this was on another level.

The laws oozing from the branches turned into complete runic dao. Other golden laws displayed their reverence to the ultimate ruler. It made people wonder if the power of Gold Village came from this tree alone.

The primal ancestors’ golden powers looked like rivers compared to this ocean.

A gigantic youth walked out from the tree. He had a shining pair of antlers capable of prying the heaven open. His body was made of gold, evident by his bare chest.

“Lord Alch-deer!” All living beings shouted his title.

No one in Gold Village could compare to him in terms of golden power alone. After countless years in this strange temporal dimension, he stood strong and was unbeatable.

Those from the real world knew he was only a one-fruit emperor. However, they respected what he had achieved in Gold Village. Of course, some didn’t accept it such as Rising, Earthsplitter, and Iron-spear.

They were primal ancestors in the real world. Even apex emperors meant nothing to them, let alone an emperor with one fruit. The sudden reversal was too much for many to take.

However, not everything was perfect. Some lamented that if Alch-deer were a heaven ancestor in the real world, the golden boost would make him a supreme overlord.

In that case, he would be Supreme Overlord Alch-deer, not just Lord Alch-deer.

“Bam!” He took one step and entered Octagon.

When people looked up, they saw stars and moons rotating around the branches of his unimaginably colossal tree.

However, he fell to his knees immediately and respectfully shouted: “Please forgive me for not welcoming you earlier, Ancestor.”

This shocked everyone including Earthsplitter and Rising. The so-called ruler of Gold Village still kneeled like everyone else.

The natives were left speechless, unable to wake up from their stupor. Their songs sang of Lord Alch-deer’s legacy - the greatest character in Gold Village.

“You’ve been doing well.” Li Qiye permitted him to rise.

“It is thanks to you, Ancestor.” Alch-deer bowed one more time before standing up.

“You two are unworthy of fighting my ancestor.” He glanced at Rising and Earthsplitter.

In this world, even heaven ancestors stood below him. No one questioned the disdainful comment either because he was the strongest in Gold Village.
